before: 'Free' almost never means a free day in Bali — and it rarely means a free swim. Hotel pools are different: most five-star resorts do not let you simply walk in and swim — you book ahead and pay a day-pass or minimum spend. Everywhere else, read 'free' as free to enter, pay for a seat.
